select i.id,i.identifier,i.title,i.status,i.type,i.priority,i.project_id,i.cycle_id,i.parent_id,i.created_at,i.updated_at,t.key as team,u.subject as user_subject,u.name as user_name,u.email as user_email from roster.issues i join roster.teams t on t.id=i.team_id left join roster.users u on u.subject=i.assignee_subject where i.workspace_id=$1 and (not t.private or exists(select 1 from roster.team_members tm where tm.team_id=t.id and tm.subject=$2)) and t.key=$3 and true order by i.updated_at desc,i.id desc limit $4

with labels as (
      select il.issue_id,jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) order by l.name_key,l.id) as labels
      from roster.issue_labels il join roster.labels l on l.id=il.label_id
      where il.workspace_id=$1 and il.issue_id=any($2::uuid[])
      group by il.issue_id
    )
    select i.id as issue_id,p.id as project_id,p.name as project,p.emoji as project_emoji,
           coalesce(labels.labels,'[]'::jsonb) as labels,parents.identifier as parent
    from roster.issues i
    left join roster.projects p on p.id=i.project_id and p.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
    left join labels on labels.issue_id=i.id
    left join (
      select pi.id,pi.workspace_id,pi.identifier from roster.issues pi join roster.teams t on t.id=pi.team_id
      where (not t.private or exists(select 1 from roster.team_members tm where tm.team_id=t.id and tm.subject=$3))
    ) parents on parents.id=i.parent_id and parents.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
    where i.workspace_id=$4 and i.id=any($5::uuid[])
select w.*,m.role from roster.workspaces w left join roster.workspace_members m on m.workspace_id=w.id and m.subject=$1 and m.status='active' where w.slug=$2

select
        (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object('actor_name',u.name,'actor_email',u.email) order by a.id),'[]'::jsonb) from roster.comments a left join roster.users u on u.subject=a.actor_subject where a.workspace_id=$1 and a.issue_id=$2) as comments,
        (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.id),'[]'::jsonb) from roster.links a where a.workspace_id=$3 and a.issue_id=$4) as links,
        (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object('actor_name',u.name,'actor_email',u.email) order by a.id),'[]'::jsonb) from roster.issue_delegations a left join roster.users u on u.subject=a.actor_subject where a.workspace_id=$5 and a.issue_id=$6) as delegations,
        (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object('actor_name',u.name,'actor_email',u.email) order by a.id desc),'[]'::jsonb) from roster.work_logs a left join roster.users u on u.subject=a.actor_subject where a.workspace_id=$7 and a.issue_id=$8 and a.kind='decision') as decisions,
        (select count(*) from roster.work_logs where workspace_id=$9 and issue_id=$10) as work_log_count,
        (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.updated_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) from roster.pull_requests a where a.workspace_id=$11 and a.issue_identifier=$12) as pull_requests

with edges as (
        select 'blocks' as direction,other_id as id from roster.relations where workspace_id=$1 and kind='blocks' and issue_id=$2
        union select 'blocked_by',issue_id from roster.relations where workspace_id=$3 and kind='blocks' and other_id=$4
        union select 'related',other_id from roster.relations where workspace_id=$5 and kind='related' and issue_id=$6
        union select 'related',issue_id from roster.relations where workspace_id=$7 and kind='related' and other_id=$8
      ), visible_issues as (
        select i.*,t.key as team,u.subject as user_subject,u.name as user_name,u.email as user_email from roster.issues i join roster.teams t on t.id=i.team_id left join roster.users u on u.subject=i.assignee_subject where i.workspace_id=$9 and (not t.private or exists(select 1 from roster.team_members tm where tm.team_id=t.id and tm.subject=$10)) and i.id in(select id from edges)
      ) select i.*,edges.direction from visible_issues i join edges on edges.id=i.id order by i.updated_at desc,i.id desc,edges.direction
